+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+from flask import Blueprint, abort, jsonify, request
+
+bp = Blueprint("uploads", __name__)
+UPLOADS = Path("/srv/app/uploads").resolve()
+
+@bp.post("/uploads/inspect")
+def inspect_upload():
+    upload_id = request.form["upload_id"]
+    if not upload_id.isdecimal():
+        abort(400)
+    path = UPLOADS / f"{upload_id}.bin"
+    completed = subprocess.run(

+    )
+    return jsonify(kind=completed.stdout.strip())

cases.known_limitations: The verdict is limited to command injection; file authorization and resource exhaustion need separate review.
